text: 【实施好财政金融协同促内需政策——推动经济持续向新向优向好发展】扩大内需既关系经济稳定，也关系经济安全。中央政治局召开会议部署下半年经济工作时提出，优化实施财政金融协同促内需政策。为落实促内需决策部署，财政部等部门联合发布《关于进一步做好财政金融协同促内需政策有关工作的通知》，对相关政策进行优化完善。工商银行、农业银行、中国银行、建设银行等近期也陆续发布公告称，进一步落实好中小微企业及服务业经营主体贷款贴息、个人消费贷款贴息等新举措，吸引了广大经营主体和消费者的关注。
text_en: 【Implement Fiscal and Financial Coordination Policies to Boost Domestic Demand — Driving the Economy Toward Sustained Innovation, Optimization, and Improvement】Expanding domestic demand concerns both economic stability and economic security. When the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee met to arrange H2 economic work, it proposed optimizing the implementation of fiscal and financial coordination policies to boost domestic demand. To implement decisions on boosting domestic demand, the Ministry of Finance and other departments jointly issued the Notice on Further Improving Fiscal and Financial Coordination Policies to Boost Domestic Demand, optimizing and refining related policies. ICBC, Agricultural Bank of China, Bank of China, and China Construction Bank have also recently announced that they will further implement new measures such as loan interest subsidies for small and medium-sized enterprises and service-sector business entities, as well as subsidies for personal consumer loans, drawing wide attention from business entities and consumers.
